title: aligning security compliance and devops: a longitudinal study
core_idea: Adapt DevOps to meet security regulations by presenting REFA, a prescriptive security-compliant DevOps lifecycle model based on IEC 62443-4-1, to help professionals (not only security experts) implement compliant DevOps processes and transfer compliance knowledge to product development teams.
tldr: Proposes a framework (REFA) that adapts DevOps to security regulations (IEC 62443-4-1) to enable professionals and cross-functional teams to implement and internalize continuous security compliance during the transition to DevOps.
